title: KRN architecture program: judge panel, Fable decision, ADRs and one tracked plan
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-15 ~20:50-21:00 (verbatim in .krn/runs/audit-1115/program.md): audit every sector, independent specialised judge panel with scientific approach, Fable picks the most mature breakthrough direction; split into separate repositories allowed (memory/brain, research lab, anything not belonging in KRN); architecture/pattern decisions; map current capabilities; onboarding KRN must make any project clean, debt-free, with categorised tasks; decide task storage (one JSONL vs file per task) with evidence; every agent aware of plans.
Why: 52% of commits are delivery machinery, brain loop not closed, zero real adopters, research manual (.krn/runs/audit-1115/*.md).
Outcome: phases 1-3 of .krn/runs/audit-1115/program.md done: map.md, judge-J1..J10 files, Fable decision; ADRs committed under docs/adr/, tracked docs/program/plan.md read by every agent at session start, tasks per slice created.

Proof: ls docs/adr/ shows the new ADRs and docs/program/plan.md exists on main; krn task list shows the program slices.
